literal: Cultivate the friendship of those who are free from blemish; even by giving something, abandon the friendship of those who lack suitability.
translation: Cultivate the friendship of those who are free from faults; even if you must give away something to do so, abandon the friendship of those who are unsuitable.
modern: குற்றமற்றவர்களுடைய நட்பை விரும்பி ஏற்றுக்கொள்ளுங்கள்; நமக்குத் தகுதி இல்லாதவர்களுடைய நட்பை, ஏதேனும் ஒன்றை அவர்களுக்குக் கொடுத்தாவது கைவிடுங்கள்.
explanation: This couplet advises the learner on how to choose and manage relationships. It urges us to seek and embrace the friendship of those who are pure and free from moral blemishes. Conversely, we must distance ourselves from those who lack compatibility or proper character. The poet emphasizes that we should be willing to give up something of value, if necessary, as a price to safely sever ties with unsuitable companions.
